lines.en: label otohaspecial10:
The two of us make our way across town and, while I think about asking Otoha if she needs any help carrying her things, I decide against it because the walk is kind of long.
Not extremely long, but long enough to make me not want to carry her things. Which I guess would be any amount of distance whatsoever.
But that’s beside the point.
Either way, she doesn’t seem to mind as she gets caught up in a text conversation with who I imagine is either Rin or a mysterious secret girlfriend she is keeping on the side.
Maybe that’s why Otoha doesn’t want Rin to meet her parents? Maybe they’ve already met her real girlfriend?
I can admire that.
I’ll have to ask her about how she manages to effectively keep her primary relationship hidden once we finish descending this suspicious staircase.
scene otohabasement1
: Something wrong, bud?
: Do you really sing in here? Because I feel like this sort of environment would just kill the mood.
: The acoustics are nice at least.
I guess Otoha and Rin really weren’t kidding when they were talking about the sketchy basement Otoha gets her vocal lessons in.
To think someone like Niki would willingly spend time in a place like this is a little bizarre to me, though.
I get that her whole idol persona isn’t really the true “her,” but I can’t imagine the true her would like something dark and damp either.
But hey, if Otoha is fine spending time in a room where someone has probably been murdered, more power to her.
: Oh, good. You’re-
scene otohabasement2
: Wait, why are you here?
: I want to learn how to sing.
: Oh, okay. So Otoha tried to come alone and you followed her?
: Stop knowing me so well. It makes my sarcasm less funny.
scene otohabasement3
: You guessed it. Sorry that he knows where you work now. I understand if you want to relocate and I’m willing to help you find some other sketchy basement if you want.
: It’s fine. If it was anyone else, I’d be a little disappointed. But I’ve gotten pretty good at dealing with this thing over the years.
: So I’m just a thing now?
scene otohabasement4
: Yes, but only just barely.
: You can stay here and watch, but if you do anything to disturb my lesson, I’m...going to be really mad.
: I am shaking in my boots.
scene otohabasement5
: Oh, I brought back all those CDs and DVDs you lent me, and you were totally right. It’s really easy to see how you’ve improved over the years if you check everything out side by side.
: I’m still getting better, too. And before long, I’m sure someone else will be saying the same sort of things about your performances.
: This is boring.
scene otohabasement6
: Okay, now you can leave.
: What exactly did you expect when you agreed to come to a singing lesson?
: Well, singing for one.
: We’ve been here for a grand total of two and a half minutes. I don’t even know what today’s lesson is on yet.
scene otohabasement7
: Oh, we’ll be working on your stamina today. The longer you’re able to last, the better and more consistent your performance will be.
Wow, maybe I do want to learn how to sing after all.
: You’re not going to make me, like...dance are you? Because I can not fucking dance to save my life. And I’m not really trying to be an idol either.
: I’m not going to make you dance. I’m talking more about vocal stamina anyway.
: And, while dancing does help to build up cardio and exercise your lungs, there are ways to improve it without going down that path.
: Welp, I’m ready whenever you are.
scene otohabasement8
: Are you able to behave yourself while I show you how a real teacher does her job? Or are you going to continue annoying us until we pay attention to you?
: I’ll just hang out on the couch until the lesson is over.
: If you’re going to watch porn on your phone, please keep the volume muted.
: Or just...don’t watch porn on your phone.
: You two are really asking a lot of me today.
: I think not watching porn on my instructor’s couch is a pretty fair thing to ask in exchange for following me across town.
: Fine. But I’m only agreeing to prevent Niki from “getting really mad.” I have no idea how I would survive something as rare and unheard of as that.
: Have I told you that I hate you yet today? Because I hate you.
scene black
Otoha and Niki move to the other side of the room, but that isn’t really saying much since this basement is only slightly larger than my bedroom.
I take a seat on the couch and observe my surroundings but, after running out of things to look at after only twenty seconds, I begin to focus on Otoha and Niki instead.
It’s refreshing to see the two of them out here this early in the morning just...doing what they love.
Even if what they love is no fun to observe if it’s not on some sort of stage.
scene otohabasement9
Otoha takes her position near the stairs, straightening her body out and awaiting Niki’s instructions.
It’s the first time I’ve actually seen her interested in learning something but, to be fair, it’s not like I’ve created many opportunities for her to feel that way.
Maybe I should, though.
I mean, if Niki’s going to go out of her way to-
You know what? Nope. I can’t do it.
I seriously contemplated the idea of teaching for a fraction of a second right there and I can already feel myself falling asleep.
scene otohabasement10
Oh, good. Someone probably felt that I was in trouble and is calling to keep me occupied and prevent me from falling asleep.
: Please tell me you’re not going to-
scene otohabasement11
: Hello?
: ...answer that.
: Otoha! Eyes forward. Don’t pay any attention to him.
scene otohabasement12
: Got it.
: If you’re ever going to make it as a musician, you’re going to have to learn how to avoid distractions.
: Let’s make the most of this opportunity by pretending he’s some asshole in the crowd.
: Now, deep breaths. Take in as much air as you can and start warming up with the two octave pitch glide tactic I taught you. Whenever you’re ready.
: Without the piano this time. You should be able to remember the notes by now. And I will call you out if you’re off key.
: Understood.
scene otohabasement13
: Hello? Is anyone there?
: Oh! Yeah. Hey. Sorry, I thought I heard Otoha and- wait, yeah. That’s definitely Otoha.
: Is she...is she fucking moaning right now?? What is that noise?? What the fuck are-
: I’m at her singing lesson...
: Oh, right! She had one of those today.
: I was wondering why you didn’t show up to the cafe this morning. But now that I know you’re at her-
: Wait. Nope. Still not making any sense to me.
: Are her parents there too? Am I the only one not invited?
: Yeah. Her entire extended family is here and we’re all saying bad things about you.
: Ha ha ha. Do you guys have any plans after that? Because I have to work a little later today and I wanted you to come keep me company.
: But if both of you are together, that’s even bet- WAIT. IDEA.
: Otoha’s instructor is your ex, right? How “ex” is she exactly? Like...if I were to propose that all four of us went out on a double date tonight, would that be weird?
: For me? No. But I figured you’d be a little hesitant given the current state of things.
: Me? Nah. I’m over it.
: Well, not really. But this sounds fun and I kind of, like...need to get out and do something.
: I’ll ask them, but-
: Shit! Like six million people just walked in. Gotta go, Sensei! Ask Otoha to check her phone whenever she’s done!
: Sounds good. Talk to you later, Rin.
: AAAAaaaaaaAAAAAaaaa-
scene otohabasement14
: Wait, Rin? Why was Rin calling you?
: Ah-ah-ah! Eyes forward!
scene otohabasement15
: Oh, yeah. Sorry...It’s just that the two of us are kind of fighting right now and-
: Singing now, drama later. You need to get your head in the game.
: You think the audience would give two shits about what’s happening between you and your girlfriend? No. Because the audience wouldn’t even know about your girlfriend.
: In fact, the audience is your girlfriend. As long as you’re up on stage, they are the only thing that matters.
: Now, keep going.
scene otohabasement16
: Right now? But you’re still holding-
: Keep. Going.
scene otohabasement17
: A...AAAAAAaaaaaAAAAAaaaaAAAAAHHH...
scene black

Feeling that I’ve already annoyed Niki and Otoha (But mostly Otoha) enough during this lesson, I decide to remain quiet this time around and focus on the two of them as they get lost in their element.

Despite not properly following orders or whatever is going on, Otoha’s voice is both powerful and beautiful- which says a lot since she’s just cycling through one sound at different pitches right now.
And Niki...Well, she is just as much of a demon as always. But she clearly knows what she’s doing and is a lot more serious about teaching than I expected her to be.
: AAAAAAaaaaaah-
: Stop. No. What is that? What are you doing?
: Huh? What? I...don’t know. What did I do wrong? It sounded fine in my head.
: Yeah, that’s exactly the problem. Look-
scene otohabasement18
: Woah! Niki?
: Stop focusing so much on your head. Your voice is fine when you sing with that section of your body. What you’re struggling with is down here.
: If you’re going to drop octaves, keeping everything up in your head is going to sound fucking horrible. You need to focus on your diaphragm more.
: How does it feel when I press there?
: Uhhhhh...I don’t know?
scene otohabasement19
: Liar. Try singing right now.
: I...can’t.
: Exactly. Because if I’m pressing down like this, it’s impairing your ability to not only breathe, but to bend and create sounds.
: I mean...yeah, but...that’s not really what I-
: Learning to use this properly is going to be a major key in controlling your stamina and expanding your range.
: It sucks right now because all you’re doing is singing with your head. It’s no wonder you always sound so strained after a few songs.
scene otohabasement20
: And why the fuck is your face so red right now? Are you embarrassed? Why? There is one person watching you.
: If you’re this red now, I can only imagine how you’ll be when you’ve got thousands of people watching.
: Assuming you’re ever able to perform for more than ten minutes without your vocal cords giving out and-
scene black
: Sorry, just gotta...run to the bathroom really quick! Be back soon!
Otoha breaks away from Niki and darts up the stairs, leaving the two of us alone in the basement together.
scene otohabasement21
: So...having fun?
: You do realize why she was actually blushing that hard, right?
: Because I’m hot and famous and I was touching her. Anyone with even half of a brain cell would blush like that.
: But I’m not just going to come out and say that to her when it would embarrass her so badly that she’d never come back.
: That just means more free time for you.
: I don’t care about free time for myself. Otoha’s got serious potential, and I’ll be damned if I don’t help her get every last drop of it out.
: You-
: If you make a fucking penis joke right now, I swear to God I’ll fucking kill you.
: I was just going to say that I admire how strict and dedicated you are to your students. You’re a real role model, Niki.
: I know I am. But thanks anyway.
: Okay! Back.
scene otohabasement22
: Sorry about that. Just needed to get some fresh air.
: In the bathroom?
: There was a window?
: Whatever. Just get back into position and we’ll start on some more stamina-
: Oh, before that.
scene otohabasement23
: What do you mean before that? We’re on my time right now. I don’t have all fucking day.
: I know. I just wanted to see if you’d go on a date with me.
scene otohabasement24
: Wait...an actual date? Like...just the two of us?
: Yeah.
: And Otoha.
: I’m sorry. What?
scene otohabasement25
: Oh, you better have a good fucking explanation for this.
: You know, I actually do this time.
: Well, then? Out with it.
scene black
I tell Otoha and Niki about Rin’s double date idea and both of them seem to be completely fine with it after a short discussion.
Strangely enough, it’s actually Otoha who needs a little prodding in order to agree. But I’m sure that’s just because I’m going to be there.
Niki, on the other hand, is all for the idea.
In fact, she likes it so much that she even offers to have one of the drivers from her agency come pick us up after a choreography session she has booked after Otoha’s lesson.
Not wanting to impose, however, Otoha rejects the idea and uses the whole “Improving her stamina” thing as an excuse to walk there instead.
Eventually, the two of them are able to get back to Otoha’s lesson, while I-
Well...
Let’s just say I wound up watching something on my phone that neither of them wanted me to watch for the next hour.
But...
At least it was muted.
